pr_title: Fix system messages appearing out of order in chat display

issue_context.title: System errors in multi chat show up as most recent in in-game chat
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/21433
Originally posted by **Axilotl17** November 27, 2022 system errors in multi chat show up as most recent in in-game chat. also, chat is not available before the map, as it is in breaks. it probably should be. https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/78441708/204110244-4b35a237-c6c6-4d78-86ae-2ec28b9848d6.mp4

review_comments: Real unfortunate but I can't see any way to avoid it...

Why was the `ChannelId` removed entirely here?

I always get jittery at `.ToString()` changes, as they may break literally anything anywhere, although this one doesn't look like it would have been used anywhere user-facing.

Yeah.. I'm not sure what to do about these scenarios. This particular case is only for debug output, and my rationale for not including the `ChannelId` is that usually messages are grouped by channel already, so it's rarely of concern.

Slightly related, we may want to look at moving to `DebuggerDisplayAttribute` at some point for cases like this, to remove all concern of breakage.

Can't help but notice that messages with IDs used to use timestamp for comparison in the old code, but now are using IDs. In theory this should be equivalent, but I think this may subtly reorder messages in edge cases, as the timestamp looks to be [generated on the php side](https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/blob/571a3645e9358e61198b24d5fb9c4ea2ce22a60c/app/Models/Chat/Channel.php#L460) when the message is received, while the message ID will presumably be assigned by mysql-side autoincrement. So in theory they may not always be the same given concurrent message submissions. Not sure if actual issue.
Yep. I think this is more correct now though, as it will match across the board.
